name: Memory
description: What Eris knows about you, kept on this computer (ADR 0095): the facts and preferences she remembers and the turns she keeps. Search them, edit a fact, forget one, or forget everything.

commands.title: Memory: What Eris knows
commands.description: Open the Memory window so the person can review what Eris keeps.

commands.title: Find entries in Memory
commands.description: Find remembered facts or conversations by query and optional kind. Omit the query to list recent entries.

commands.title: Forget a named Memory entry
commands.description: Forget one entry by its exact id from endue.memory.find after the person approves it. Answers how many entries were removed.
